analysis.title: How can I take advantage of volatility?
key_insights: Shifting market narratives around AI, debt, inflation and geopolitics may keep generating periods of higher volatility, which UBS frames as a source of opportunity.

AI-related earnings point to robust demand and encouraging monetization, but markets are focused on whether AI spending is sustainable given physical and financing constraints and whether revenues justify the investment.
Higher-than-expected inflation data and hawkish Fed comments have added to market expectations for further rate hikes.
The VIX reached nearly 36 on 20 November, its highest level since the Liberation Day tariff turmoil in April 2025.
Capital preservation strategies can retain some participation in market rallies while limiting losses. Stronger preservation generally reduces participation in gains.
Structured yield strategies such as reverse convertibles use option premiums to turn elevated volatility into income, in exchange for accepting defined equity risk.
Investors with large gains, concentrated holdings, low drawdown tolerance or near-term liquidity needs may consider adding a put warrant to an existing position.
Investors holding more cash than their long-term plan suggests may consider a capital preservation strategy for measured market participation.
Structured strategies carry capital loss risk, limited liquidity, issuer credit risk, conditional returns and opportunity costs. They reshape risk and do not eliminate it.
earnings_insights: AI-related company earnings recently pointed to robust underlying demand and encouraging monetization, though no specific EPS or revenue figures are cited.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Highest since April 2025 tariff turmoil, so option premiums are elevated, which supports structured yield strategies and raises the cost of buying protection.

macro_indicators.reading: market expectations for further rate hikes
macro_indicators.interpretation: Hot inflation data and hawkish Fed comments have pushed markets toward pricing more hikes, adding to volatility.

trade_ideas.description: Add a put warrant to an existing large-gain or concentrated equity position to limit losses
trade_ideas.rationale: Limits downside for investors with large gains, concentrated holdings, low drawdown tolerance or upcoming liquidity needs.
trade_ideas.risk: Cost of the warrant, plus structured product risks of limited liquidity and issuer credit.

trade_ideas.description: Buy a capital preservation structured strategy with partial or full principal protection at maturity
trade_ideas.rationale: Suits investors holding excess cash who want measured market participation while preserving some or all of the initial investment.
trade_ideas.risk: Reduced participation in gains, losses on early sale, dependence on issuer credit-worthiness and holding period.

trade_ideas.description: Buy a structured yield strategy such as a reverse convertible to monetize elevated volatility
trade_ideas.rationale: Option premiums turn volatility into potential income for investors able to bear equity losses.
trade_ideas.risk: Defined equity downside is retained, with limited liquidity and issuer risk.

risk_factors: AI spending sustainability given physical and financing constraints, and whether AI revenues justify the investment.
Inflation running above expectations and hawkish Fed comments raising rate hike expectations.
Debt and geopolitical concerns as sources of volatility.
Structured product risks include capital loss, limited liquidity, issuer credit risk, conditional returns and opportunity cost.
